elements.name: enabled
elements.title: Screen new tickets for spam
elements.description: Applies to tickets customers create in the app or by email. Agents' tickets are never screened.

choices.text: Flag it: add the "spam" tag and keep it open
Close it: no SLA timer, no new-ticket notifications

elements.name: blocked_domains
elements.title: Blocked sender domains
elements.description: One domain per line; example.com also covers mail.example.com.

elements.name: keywords
elements.title: Keywords and phrases
elements.description: One per line; matched case-insensitively in the title and the first post.

elements.name: patterns
elements.title: Regular expressions
elements.description: One per line, case-insensitive, same scope as keywords. Example: (seo|backlinks?).*(offer|price)

elements.name: ai_enabled
elements.title: Also ask the AI when no rule matches
elements.description: Uses the provider from Admin > AI Configuration. Runs after the ticket is created, so customers never wait for it.

elements.name: ai_threshold
elements.title: AI spam probability from which a ticket counts as spam
